description: This PHP source file defines a service class named SugarSoapService2 for SOAP web service handling in a SuiteCRM/SugarCRM environment. It extends the NusoapSoap class and provides a register method to expose available SOAP functions, with logging and registration logic.

classes.name: SugarSoapService2
classes.description: A service class for version 2 that extends the NusoapSoap class, provides a register method to expose functions for SOAP communication.

methods.name: register
methods.description: Registers all functions for SOAP access, excluding specified functions, with logging.
